table_description: Desired state of platform services from git manifests (infra/dokploy/apps/**). Declarations include templates, one-shot dependencies and unverified intent; a declaration is not proof of an active deployment.
use_cases: See what services are declared in git
Compare desired images against actual running images
Identify services without Traefik routing labels
data_quality_notes: image_tag may be a floating tag like '5.x-alpine' — compare carefully with actual
domains is a TEXT[] array — use ANY() or && operators for array queries
traefik_labels is JSONB — use ->> operator for label access
source_file points to the git manifest path for traceability
Refreshed on each ETL run — loaded_at shows when last parsed
Join on host and service_name; environment is a logical scope and may differ from host.
Runtime names use verified catalog mappings. Check inventory_unverified drift before describing an unmatched declaration as an outage.

table_columns.name: host
table_columns.description: Expected workload host; distinct from logical environment

table_columns.name: source_file
table_columns.description: Git path to the source manifest
